sql:
SELECT label 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id 
    FROM bond b 
    JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id 
    WHERE b.bond_type = '= ' 
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id 
    ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)
AND label = '+'
